gloss: suddenly, in haste, on short notice

definitions.gloss: suddenly, in haste, on short notice, at the last minute
definitions.explanation: Doing something hastily or without advance planning, typically because of unexpected circumstances. Implies urgency and a change from the original plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急遽|きゅうきょ}⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧になった。
{急遽|きゅうきょ}⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧ことになった。
examples.english: We had to find a replacement member on short notice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{急遽|きゅうきょ}⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦せざる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}なかった→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the typhoon, we had no choice but to change our plans at the last minute.

notes:
USAGE:
{急遽|きゅうきょ} implies that an action was taken hastily due to unforeseen circumstances. It differs from ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧ (suddenly), which simply describes something happening without warning. {急遽|きゅうきょ} emphasizes the reactive, last-minute nature of a decision or action.

Common in news reporting and business contexts. Slightly more formal than ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急遽|きゅうきょ}⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧: to be decided on short notice
- {急遽|きゅうきょ}⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧: to change at the last minute
- {急遽|きゅうきょ}⟦{帰国|きこく}する→帰国する：21786_kikokusuru⟧: to return home urgently
- {急遽|きゅうきょ}⟦{開催|かいさい}する→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧: to hold (an event) on short notice
